finding: The tiled trailing-update kernel gates shared A-panel loads on active=(j<ntrail && r<nRows). A-panel loader lanes are needed across the whole reduction tile even when their output columns are beyond ntrail. At n=513, trailing widths end in a one-column partial 16-column tile. Only threadIdx.x=0 loads the A-panel there; lanes 1 through 15 substitute zero, so the valid last output column omits 15 of each 16 products. In the retained lower triangle this corrupts the final diagonal update.
observed_failure: The exclusive hybrid check at n=513 exits 1 after reconstruction reports maximum absolute error 2.9291971698 and maximum relative error 0.0052663916433. It prints Validation: FAILED. Its last diagonal sample is 23.5811125373990436 rather than the reference approximately 23.5189215597066088.
interpretation: The partial-tile load predicate is a concrete pre-existing numerical defect consistent with the last-diagonal and reconstruction errors. No source or input was changed and no retry was performed. The added case is classified at the external-validation stage.
investigation: Static inspection and retained validation output; no retry.
